B.note: Four live pitches in 960-1034, all thrown by TAYLOR from the centre-field camera. The NBC score bug is at top left: score 6-3, arrow plus inning, bases diamond, outs as filled dots, then count and pitch clock. The bottom row shows the pitcher name and P: count before the pitch, then switches to pitch type and mph after it. Non-pitch footage: 960-967.5 is Astros players and the crowd (960 has a replay-review banner in the background); 968-974.5 is batter and pitcher closeups; 976.5-980.5 is post-strikeout CF footage (END 8); 981-983.5 is the batter walking off; 984-989 is the Bottom 9th transition graphic; 989.5-996.5 is pitcher closeups; 1000-1002.5 is crowd; 1007.5-1013 is pitcher closeups; 1016-1021.5 is the live play at first; 1021.5-1034 is the FINAL graphic, players and fans. No slow-motion or alternate-angle replays of pitches appear in this range. Release times are rounded to the 0.5 s frame grid. For the pitches at 997.0 and 1014.5, the frame before release shows the arm cocked and the next frame shows the ball already at the plate, so the true release is about 0.1-0.3 s after the stated time.
